research_rationale: Identity: the held registered text of Executive Order 14082 is the official Federal Register text layer at 87 FR 56861, PDF pages 1-4 (Federal Register / Vol. 87, No. 179 / Friday, September 16, 2022); it names Executive Order 14082 of September 12, 2022, Implementation of the Energy and Infrastructure Provisions of the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, and runs from the title to the signature block. The complete clause inventory was checked against the numbered section headings of that text. Section 2(xx) of Executive Order 14148 of January 20, 2025 (Initial Rescissions of Harmful Executive Orders and Actions, 90 FR 8237, Federal Register of January 28, 2025) lists Executive Order 14082 of September 12, 2022 among the executive actions that section 2 declares hereby revoked. The held text of Executive Order 14148 states no effective date later than its signing, so the revocation operates from its signing date, 2025-01-20. Whole-order revocation by name is the first end of every clause that had not already been exhausted by performance. The order has no other ending instrument before 2025-01-20 in the packet's later-event chain, which for this order lists besides Executive Order 14148: Executive Order 14096 and Executive Order 14154. Each such instrument is recorded in the source notes with its date and why it is not an earlier end; none reinstates this order. The packet's name search of held order texts for this order's number returned, among texts dated on or after 2025-01-20, only Executive Order 14148 and Executive Order 14154. The later-source search is recorded by the three machine searches selected on the sheet: the U.S. Code release point 119-121 (edition current through 2026-10-09), the eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 with the CFR bulk files, and the Federal Register executive-order disposition catalog; their coverage statements were read and each is marked complete. Executive Order 14126 of 2024-09-06 cites this order by number only in its policy section, saying that the Investing in America agenda has been furthered by it; that recital neither amends, supersedes nor revokes this order and is not a later event or end. Executive Order 14173 of 2025-01-21 revokes Executive Order 12898, which this order amends; it does not name this order, so under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on unnamed instruments it is not an end, and it is a disclosed non-end candidate whose effect on the text inserted into Executive Order 12898 is addressed in the savings statement. Savings are addressed in the savings statement. The first end of the whole order is 2025-01-20.
savings_reason: Section 3(b) of Executive Order 14148 directs the Director of the Domestic Policy Council and the Director of the National Economic Council to review all Federal Government actions taken pursuant to the orders, memoranda and proclamations listed in section 2 and to take necessary steps to rescind, replace or amend such actions as appropriate. Because rescission of actions already taken is left to later action, Federal actions already taken under Executive Order 14082 before 2025-01-20 were not themselves revoked by section 2 and stood until rescinded, replaced or amended individually. No held source identifies a particular surviving action or its later fate, so none is asserted. The earlier instruments revoked or amended by the clauses executed on the order's own date stay revoked or amended: those acts are accrued effects not undone by section 2 of Executive Order 14148, except that the instruments amended, Executive Orders 14008 and 14052, are themselves revoked by section 2 of Executive Order 14148, while Executive Order 12898 is not listed in section 2 of that order, so text inserted into it by section 4(b) was not revoked by it. Section 3(a)(i) of Executive Order 14173 of 2025-01-21 (Ending Illegal Discrimination and Restoring Merit-Based Opportunity) later revokes Executive Order 12898 itself; that revocation acts on Executive Order 12898, not on any clause of this order, so it is not a later event or end for this order.
